Account Technician / Account Clerk Job at Elyon Global Shipping Limited




        
    

        
        Elyon Global Shipping Limited is a leading logistics and  shipping company dedicated to providing tailored freight services that emphasize quick transit times, cost-cutting opportunities and continuous communication. With expertise in air and sea consolidation and forwarding, we offer individually customized solutions to meet the unique needs of our clients. Our team is committed to delivering exceptional service, ensuring seamless transactions and fostering long-term relationships with our partners and customers.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Account Technician / Account Clerk 

Job Location: Lagos

Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a detail-oriented and organised Account Technician / Account Clerk to support the finance team with routine accounting, record-keeping, documentation, and administrative tasks.
	The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of basic accounting principles, strong attention to detail, and the ability to accurately handle financial records and transactions.


Key Responsibilities


	Record and post daily financial transactions accurately.
	Assist with maintaining accounting records, ledgers, and financial documentation.
	Support the preparation and processing of invoices, receipts, payment vouchers, and other accounting documents.
	Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable activities.
	Support bank and other account reconciliations.
	Verify financial documents and ensure transactions are properly supported and authorised.
	Maintain proper filing and organisation of accounting records and supporting documents.
	Assist with data entry and updating of accounting systems and spreadsheets.
	Support the Finance team with routine month-end accounting activities.
	Assist in preparing schedules and basic financial reports as assigned.
	Follow up on outstanding invoices, payments, and other accounting-related matters when required.
	Ensure confidentiality and proper handling of financial information.
	Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned.


Requirements


	Maximum of OND in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	0-2 years of relevant work experiencein accounting, finance, or a related role.
	Basic understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
	Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
	Familiarity with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Sage, or similar software is an added advantage.
	Good numerical and data-entry skills.
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good organisational and record-keeping skills.
	Ability to follow instructions and work effectively with minimal supervision.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
	Willingness to learn and develop professionally.

Technical Sales Leader Job at Elyon Technik Limited




        
    

        
        Elyon Technik Limited specializes in aircraft parts supply, maintenance solutions, and defense consulting. Backed by decades of industry expertise, we deliver reliable support to clients across commercial, business and military aviation.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Technical Sales Leader 

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Elyon Technik Limited is seeking an experienced and commercially driven Technical Sales Leader to lead the development of new business opportunities across technical, engineering and industrial markets.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for breaking into new markets, identifying high-value technical sales opportunities, building strategic relationships and converting opportunities into profitable business.
	We are looking for a hunter, not just an account manager, someone who can identify opportunities, open doors, engage decision-makers and close complex B2B deals.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute strategies for growing technical sales and business development.
	Identify and pursue new markets, customers and revenue opportunities.
	Prospect and build relationships with corporate, industrial, engineering, procurement and technical decision-makers.
	Sell technical products, machinery, equipment, components, engineering solutions and related services.
	Understand customer requirements and develop appropriate technical/commercial solutions.
	Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and proposal development to negotiation and closing.
	Identify tenders, RFQs, procurement opportunities and strategic projects.
	Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline and provide accurate sales forecasts.
	Build strategic relationships with OEMs, manufacturers, distributors and other technical partners.
	Lead, mentor and develop the technical sales team.
	Provide management with market intelligence, sales reports and recommendations for growth.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Marketing, Sales or a related field.
	Minimum of 7 years of verifiable experience in technical, industrial, engineering, technology or equipment sales.
	Proven track record of winning new business and meeting/exceeding sales targets.
	Experience selling machinery, mechanical equipment, industrial/technical products, engineering solutions or other complex B2B products/services.
	Strong experience in business development, prospecting and consultative/solution-based selling.
	Strong commercial negotiation and deal-closing skills.
	Ability to engage confidently with technical teams, procurement professionals and senior executives.
	Existing industry contacts and knowledge of the Nigerian B2B market will be an advantage.
	Experience with CRM and sales pipeline management.
	Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.


What We Are Looking For:


	Candidates should be able to demonstrate measurable achievements such as major contracts won, new accounts acquired, revenue generated, markets developed or significant technical products/equipment sold.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their CV and a brief cover letter highlighting their technical sales and business development experience to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Social Media Specialist/ Graphics Designer Job at HOP Services




        
    

        
        HOP Services is a leading hospitality solutions provider based in Port Harcourt, Nigeria. We specialize in Hospitality Management and Consulting, Professional Bespoke Hospitality Training Programs through HOP Academy, and Comprehensive Cleaning Services via Certified Third parties. Our mission is to keep our environment clean and empower the hospitality sector to deliver high-quality experiences. Serve businesses across Nigeria with guaranteed quality standards, fully trained professional staff, and bespoke packages backed by a guaranteed satisfaction.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Social Media Specialist/ Graphics Designer
     

            
    



Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview


	We are looking for a highly skilled, creative, and technology-driven Digital Marketing, Social Media & Creative Specialist who can independently manage the day-to-day digital marketing needs of multiple business units under HOP Services.
	This is a hands-on, multidisciplinary role combining social media management, graphic design, content creation, digital advertising, community management and marketing technology.
	This is an execution-focused role.
	The successful candidate will be expected to actively create, design, publish, manage, advertise, analyse and optimise digital marketing activities rather than simply coordinate them.
	The candidate must be comfortable working across multiple brands, managing competing priorities and taking ownership of assigned tasks from start to completion.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute social media and digital marketing strategies across assigned brands.
	Plan, create, schedule and publish engaging content across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and other relevant platforms.
	Design professional graphics for social media, campaigns, advertisements, flyers, promotional materials and other marketing needs.
	Create and edit short-form videos, reels and other digital content.
	Manage online communities, comments, DMs, enquiries, reviews and audience interactions professionally and promptly.
	Set up, manage, monitor and optimise paid advertising campaigns, particularly Meta Ads.
	Conduct audience research, creative testing, retargeting and campaign optimisation.
	Monitor marketing performance, analyse data and prepare reports with clear recommendations.
	Support lead generation, promotions, email marketing, WhatsApp marketing and other digital campaigns.
	Maintain consistent brand identity and quality across all digital platforms.
	Use AI and emerging technologies for research, content creation, design, automation, productivity and marketing optimisation.
	Manage digital marketing tools, platforms and digital assets efficiently.
	Stay current with social media trends, digital marketing developments, AI tools and emerging content formats.
	Work closely with the Marketing Lead to execute campaigns, launches, events and strategic marketing initiatives.
	Manage multiple brands, deadlines and projects while maintaining quality and attention to detail.
	Track analytics and prepare basic weekly reports on follower growth, reach, engagement, and content performance, and prepare a report for weekly team meetings.
	Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Marketing, Communications, Mass Communication, Digital Media, Business Administration or a related field.
	Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience.
	Proven experience managing social media accounts for businesses or brands.
	Demonstrable experience with graphic design, content creation and video editing.
	Practical experience running and managing paid advertising campaigns.
	Strong working knowledge of digital and AI tools.
	A portfolio of previous work is required.
	Experience working with multiple brands or in hospitality, tourism, lifestyle, real estate or service-based businesses is an advantage.


Required Skills & Competencies


	The candidate must have practical ability in:
	
		Graphic design
		Social media management
		Digital marketing
		Content creation
		Video editing
		Meta Ads and paid advertising
		Community management
		Content strategy and copywriting
		Marketing analytics and reporting
		Basic photography/videography
		AI-assisted content creation and automation
		Digital marketing tools and platforms
		Brand management
		The candidate must also demonstrate excellent organisation, communication, creativity, problem-solving, time management, attention to detail and the ability to multitask.
	
	


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidate should email their CV, Portfolio (if any), any sample content or personal social media handles (optional), to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
